# Ticketmaster Discovery API

Public events feed, used by [[farely]] to know when Wrocław venues will empty. It is the **live** tier
of {{event-driven-demand-positioning}} — inbound only, key-gated, and fail-soft.

## The request

`liveEvents.ts` issues a single `GET /events.json` with `city=Wroclaw`, `countryCode=PL`, `locale=*`,
`size=100`, `sort=date,asc`, over a window from one hour ago to 21 days out. The driver supplies the
API key in Settings; it lives in `localStorage` alongside the Anthropic one — same storage, same
unstated plaintext caveat noted on [[anthropic-messages-api]].

**With no key the module is a silent no-op.** No error, no prompt, no degraded banner: the seeded
venue calendar simply remains the only source. That is what keeps an external dependency compatible
with [[on-device-first-inference]] — the network is an upgrade tier, not a precondition.

## The mapping work

The interesting part is not the fetch, it is the normalisation into the app's own `VenueEvent` model:

- Ticketmaster **segment → `kind`**, so a concert and a football match are priced as different demand
  shapes.
- Venue matched against **seven seeded Wrocław venues**, or synthesised from the response's own
  geo-coordinates when unrecognised.
- Synthesised venues are snapped to the **nearest known zone**, so `zoneEph` stays valid and a live
  event can never introduce a zone the rest of the demand model has never heard of.
- Crowd size inferred from venue name and segment.

Provenance is preserved: `upcomingEvents` merges tiers **live > listing > typical**, and each event
keeps its `source` — [[provenance-and-limits-stated-inline]].

## Why this API and not a scrape

It is the only one of Farely's four network dependencies that is genuinely a *data* source rather than
infrastructure. The others — the [[anthropic-messages-api]] classifier, fueleconomy.gov car specs, and
OpenFreeMap tiles via [[maplibre-gl]] — are respectively outbound, reference lookup, and rendering.

- `TODO:` no rationale is recorded for choosing Ticketmaster over any other events source, and no
  coverage check exists for how much of Wrocław's venue calendar it actually contains. Never exercised
  against a live shift.

## Unverified end to end

Like everything else in [[farely]], this ran only in the browser simulator. Whether the mapping holds
against a full 100-event Wrocław response in practice is untested — there is no test runner in the
repo at all.
